findings.description: System MUST read evicted data from SSD directly into GPU staging buffers, bypassing host DRAM.
findings.notes: pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_p2p reads NVMe directly into P2P ring GPU BAR1 slots via ReadAsync commands

findings.description: System MUST copy data from staging buffers to the client's GPU destination.
findings.notes: D2D cudaMemcpyAsync from ring slot dev_ptr to gpu_dst with CUDA_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_DEVICE

findings.description: System MUST pre-allocate a fixed ring of 64 GPU staging buffers at initialization via cudaMalloc + GDRCopy BAR1 mapping + spdk_mem_register. Each slot is 128 KiB (MDTS). The ring is shared across all cold lookup threads.
findings.notes: P2P_RING_SLOTS=64, cudaMalloc + create_spdk_dma_buffer_from_gpu_bar per slot, 4 CUDA streams allocated. Slot size is parameterized from drive MDTS.

findings.description: System MUST partition the staging ring for concurrent thread access using ThreadPartition (non-overlapping slot ranges, effective QD capped at 16 per thread).
findings.notes: ThreadPartition::new divides ring evenly, caps at MAX_QD_PER_THREAD=16. Unit tests verify non-overlapping partitions for 1-8 threads.

findings.description: System MUST pipeline SSD reads with D2D GPU copies using FIFO completion ordering. D2D copies distributed round-robin across 4 CUDA streams. Stream sync at ring partition wrap. Final sync after all chunks.
findings.notes: FIFO ordering via sequential completion loop, round-robin stream selection (completed % num_streams), sync at sync_interval boundaries, final stream sync loop at end.

findings.description: System MUST panic on first cold lookup if the P2P ring was not initialized. Initialization logs diagnostic but does not fail. No DRAM fallback for cold reads.
findings.notes: Initialization logs warning when P2pRing::new returns None. batch_lookup uses expect() on p2p_ref which panics on first cold lookup when ring is absent.

findings.description: The P2P ring is allocated once at initialization and is immutable for the component's lifetime. There is no runtime path selection.
findings.notes: p2p_ring field is RwLock<Option<P2pRing>> set once in initialize(), never modified until shutdown.

findings.description: System MUST implement the same interface as the standard dispatcher, serving as a drop-in replacement.
findings.notes: define_component! provides [IDispatcher]. All IDispatcher trait methods (initialize, shutdown, lookup, batch_lookup, lookup_async, check, remove, populate, prepare_store, commit_store, cancel_store, touch, promote_to_memory_tier, clear_memory_tier, flush_to_ssd) are implemented.

findings.description: System MUST promote successfully read cold entries back to DRAM after completing the read.
findings.notes: After pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_p2p succeeds, code inserts into memory-tier (mt.insert), removes old dispatch-map entry, and creates a new memory-tier entry with convert_to_storage.

findings.description: System MUST release all staging resources on shutdown with no leaks.
findings.notes: shutdown() destroys warm stream, takes and destroys P2P ring (ring.destroy frees CUDA streams and cudaFree's dev_ptrs), destroys pipeline ring, two-phase block device shutdown with signal_stop/join/detach.

findings.description: System MUST handle read failures gracefully without corrupting ring state or affecting other in-flight operations.
findings.notes: P2P pipeline returns Err on ReadDone failure or Timeout; ring slots are not resubmitted after error; other in-flight lookups in batch_lookup proceed independently per thread.

findings.description: System MUST support end-to-end performance measurement using the existing pipelined benchmark tool.
findings.notes: Minor drift: No in-component benchmark integration code. The component implements IDispatcher which the external certus-api-bench_v2.py tool exercises. A benches/ directory exists in the component but contains no P2P-specific benchmark. The requirement is satisfied at the system level, not within component source.

findings.description: System MUST implement promote_to_memory_tier(keys) to asynchronously read cold entries from NVMe into the memory-tier without GPU involvement.
findings.notes: promote_to_memory_tier groups keys by drive, spawns one thread per drive, calls pipelined_ssd_to_dram_only for each entry. No P2P ring involvement. Updates dispatch-map after successful read.

unspecced_code_details.description: Per-drive background writer threads that persist memory-tier entries to SSD asynchronously after populate(). Enables write-through without blocking the hot path.
Periodic thread that monitors SSD utilization across extent managers and evicts cold entries when a configurable threshold is exceeded.
Two-phase write API: caller gets a DMA buffer via prepare_store, fills it, then commits or cancels. Bypasses the populate->background-write path for bulk ingest.
Splits large transfers into segments respecting NVMe maximum transfer size. Used by all read/write paths.
Additional pipeline functions (pipelined_ssd_to_gpu_zero_copy, pipelined_multi_object_zero_copy, pipelined_multi_ssd_to_dram_only) that serve the DRAM fallback path and batch operations.
